prompt: Are you 18 or older and resident in this municipality?
response_options: Yes | No | Prefer not to say (screen out)

prompt: In the last 12 months, did you personally use an online municipal service?
Which online municipal service did you most recently use?
response_options: Property records | Bills | Complaint | Permit | Other | Cannot recall

prompt: Approximately how many minutes did you spend completing that request, excluding waiting for a response?
Overall how satisfied were you with that experience?
response_options: Very dissatisfied | Dissatisfied | Neither | Satisfied | Very satisfied | Prefer not to say

prompt: Did you submit a complaint about that experience?
What is the current status of the complaint?
response_options: Resolved | Pending | Closed without resolution | Do not know

prompt: Did you receive assistance from another person while using the service?
response_options: Yes | No | Prefer not to say

prompt: What is your main reason for not using an online service in the last 12 months?
response_options: No need | Prefer in-person | No internet | Unaware | Other | Prefer not to say
